pages.title: Giant Short-faced Kangaroo
pages.text: $(o)Procoptodon$() ($(o)Procoptodon goliah$()) was the largest kangaroo known, standing about 2 metres tall. It lived in Australia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It had a short, flat face and long arms with two long clawed fingers, which it probably used to pull down branches to browse.$(br2)Its hind feet each carried a single large toe, like a hoof.
